ops.loadingHours: A large lift can carry in vehicles and large exhibits (2.2 m x 2.2 m x 5.3 m, up to 3 t). (May 2026 factsheet)
ops.vehicleRules: The parking garage is entered from two places, Uchibori-dori and Eitai-dori. The entrance heights are: hotel entrance (Uchibori-dori side) 2.5 m, Eitai-dori side entrance 3 m, and loading dock (B2F) 3 m. The width (3 m) and length (6.5 m) are the same for all.
ops.parking: Underground parking for 350 cars. The fee is free for the first 30 minutes, then 500 yen per 30 minutes. There are 3 motorcycle-only spaces: free for the first 30 minutes, then 100 yen per 60 minutes. Banquet attendees get up to 4 hours free (tell the cloakroom). With restaurant use, parking is free for up to 2 hours for 5,000 yen or more and up to 4 hours for 10,000 yen or more.
ops.waitingRooms: There is a women's changing room (capacity 10) on the 2nd floor and a men's changing room (capacity 5) on the 3rd floor, with full-length mirrors and hangers provided. The floor map shows a dedicated waiting room for Aoi and a cloakroom.
ops.catering: Banquet cuisine is prepared by the hotel's chefs. Bringing in sake or wine incurs the prescribed corkage fee, and the amount is to be discussed with the banquet staff. Taking leftover food home is not possible for food hygiene reasons. Wi-Fi is free; wired LAN is 11,000 yen (tax included). There is also a catering service in which the hotel goes to a designated location (standing receptions from 30 people, seated dinners from 10 people).
ops.restaurants: The hotel has the French restaurant Esterre, the all-day dining restaurant Grand Kitchen, the Japanese restaurant Wadakura, the tempura restaurant Tatsumi, the teppanyaki restaurant GO, the Chinese restaurant Amber Palace and the sushi restaurant Sushi Kanesaka. Private room plans that can be used for private-hire parties and buffets are officially offered, and Grand Kitchen has a party plan with free-flow drinks.
